feat: engine + forms + adapters + conformance (issue #28 Wave 3, stages 3-6)
In exfer-stack/exfer-honor, his own repository.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-honor/pull/1

Builds **exfer-honor** from the frozen Stage-2 standard up to a **conformance-green, releasable** reusable library — the EXFER-QUOTE honor layer (ahuman-exfer/exfer#28).

## Stages
- **3 — core engine + atomic gate txn** (`src/core`): `HonorEngine` over the ports (register / markObserved / canHonor / honor / status / sweep); `createEngine(store)` pins the `TxnModel` so F8 holds without hand-written type args. The §5 write-ahead transaction runs the consumer's `deliver` **inside the same local txn** — gate commits only if deliver succeeds; a deliver throw rolls back the gate and re-throws (**F11**); not-already-honored re-validated in-txn (**F10**); async-under-sync stays a **compile error** (**F8**). `CLAIM_MARGIN = 12+6+1 = 19`, derived + startup-asserted.
- **4 — forms** (`src/forms`): `PlainOutputForm` (R4 exact-amount/depth/address/strict-datum, R5 consent·source) and `HtlcForm` (R3 two-phase own-claim-confirmed, CLAIM_MARGIN, preimage-in-hand, reorg-revocable, sender binding). A new form plugs in **without touching core** (example + test).
- **5 — adapters** (`src/adapters`): `SqliteStore` (`'sync'`, one-connection F12, F3 write-ahead, crash-idempotent), `PostgresStore` (`'async'`, gate+deliver one client/txn), `IndexerChainSource` (exfer-indexer Stage-1 reads + node depth, propagates `unhonorable` = M2), `WalletdVerifier`, `KeystoreKeyCustody`. Transient walletd/node faults → retryable `chain_fault`, **not** a terminal `malformed_quote` decline.
- **6 — conformance** (`src/conformance` + CI): the 21-vector corpus **executes against both reference stores** (in-memory fake + real SqliteStore); wired into `ci.yml`.

## Gates
typecheck · **test 140** · **conformance 44** (20 runtime vectors × 2 stores + guards + meta) · lint · format — all green. Load-bearing guards (F8/F3/F10/F11, HTLC own-claim-confirmed, M2) verified **non-vacuous by mutation testing**.

## Review
Each stage went through implement → parallel acceptance review → remediate. Two majors surfaced and fixed before this PR: WalletdVerifier transient-vs-terminal (above), and a missing R6 first-seen-after-expiry negative test (now asserted against both stores).

## Next
- **Stage E** — a batteries-included façade (`createHonorService` + `onPaid`) so common-case integration is ~10 lines (the 5 ports stay for advanced use).
- **Stage 7** — wire exfer-swap as consumer #1 (handled separately; that repo has unrelated in-flight work).
